gripOrHq.title: Temple Microcode Outlet
gripOrHq.rulesText: Search your stack for a program. Show that program to the Corp, and then bring it into your hand. Shuffle your stack afterwards.

heapOrArchives.title: Top Runners' Conference
heapOrArchives.rulesText: Gain [2] at the start of each of your turns. Trash Top Runners' Conference when you make a run.

scoreArea.title: Project Zurich
scoreArea.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Project Venice
scoreArea.rulesText: For every three advancement counters over Project Venice 's difficulty that are on Project Venice when you score it, gain an action during each of your turns.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

rig.title: Snowball
rig.rulesText:
Snowball has +1 strength for each subroutine it has broken during a run, until the end of that run.
[1]: Break sentry subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.

rig.title: Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker
rig.rulesText:
[1]: Break ice subroutine.
[1]: +1 strength.
After passing each piece of ice, roll a die if you used Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker to break any subroutines of that ice. On a 1, trash Bartmoss Memorial Icebreaker.

rig.title: R&D Interface
rig.rulesText: Whenever you access cards from R&D, access an additional card from R&D.

rig.title: Broker
rig.rulesText: Each of your turns, you may take only one action to use Broker. A: Put [3] from the bank on Broker. A: Take all the bits from Broker.

scoreArea.title: Data Fort Reclamation
scoreArea.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

scoreArea.title: Security Purge
scoreArea.rulesText: Show the top three cards of R&D to Runner when you score Security Purge. If any of those cards are ice, install and rez them, at no cost. Trash the rest of those cards.

ice.title: Coyote
ice.rulesText: *For the remainder of the run, all further ice is encountered at +1 strength, unless Runner pays [2] while passing Coyote. Gain [3] when you rez Coyote.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.

ice.title: Chihuahua
ice.rulesText: *Trace 1-If trace is successful, do 1 Net damage. Gain [2] when you rez Chihuahua.

root.title: Project Zurich
root.rulesText: For every two advancement counters over Project Zurich 's difficulty that are on Project Zurich when you score it, gain 1 at the start of each of your turns.

root.title: Data Fort Reclamation
root.rulesText: Gain [10] and choose up to four cards stored in HQ when you score Data Fort Reclamation. Create a new data fort using the cards chosen. Install the cards one at a time; you may rez them when you install them. Then, return to the bank any of the [10] not spent.

root.title: Colonel Failure
root.rulesText: *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *Trash a program. *End the run. *End the run.

root.title: Dr. Dreff
root.rulesText: Whenever the Runner passes the last piece of ice on this fort or declares a run on it when it has no ice, you may choose an ice card stored in HQ. Pay half of that card's rez cost, rounded down, to force Runner to encounter it; the run is not considered successful unless Runner passes that piece of ice. Trash that ice after the encounter ends. Use this ability only once during each run on this fort.

root.title: Executive Boot Camp
root.rulesText: Discard a card at random: Gain [2]. Use this ability only during a run. At the end of the run, return to the bank any of the [2] you did not spend.

root.title: Puzzle
root.rulesText: *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn. *End the run, and trash Puzzle at end of turn.

ice.title: Bug Zapper
ice.rulesText: *Do 2 Net damage for each rezzed piece of ice installed outside Bug Zapper. *End the run.
